I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Two sources Marcus can see support that. On Aug 20, 2025, Dana said in #north-team that Thea flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift. The public North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact.
